# Pki

The certificates of the fleet, and the rotation of the controller's key.
`osapi dsl endpoint get --name pki` shows the same.

## Endpoint group

|             |                                                                         |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | pki                                                                     |
| Description | The certificates of the fleet, and the rotation of the controller's key |
| Area        | fleet                                                                   |
